blocks.body:
name = "acme/clock-variant-clock"
version = "1.0.0"
[agent]
timeout = "10m"
network = "none"

[variants.frozen.sandbox]
clock = { start = "2026-03-14T09:00:00Z" }

diagnostics.message: variant frozen: [sandbox] clock needs enforce: "preload" (a library in the sandbox; fidelity, not protection), "vm" (a guest with its own clock), or "world" (the task's own services hold the time)
